title: Rehab Agent session record
description: One folder per session (docs/hardware.md protocol step 7). No direct identifiers: person_ref is pseudonymous.

person_ref.description: Pseudonymous reference only. Never a name or medical record number.

started_at_source.description: Where started_at comes from. 'processing time' is not the recording time: progress flags the session order as unreliable.

synthetic.description: True for example/test data. Must be false for real sessions.

twin_tier.description: docs/accuracy.md tiers. Tier travels with the data.

tier_source.description: Why the session has its tier: default Tier C, or a model-provenance record (file hash, evidence, approver) bound to the model by sha256.

reprojection_error_px.description: null when no multi-view calibration was performed (monocular screening session)

method.description: single-stream: one video, nothing to synchronise

proof_event.description: e.g. LED flash / hand clap at session start

max_offset_ms_after_correction.description: Must be < 5 for kinematics use (docs/hardware.md); null for single-stream sessions

pipeline.description: Software provenance: front-end/back-end, config, versions, upstream pins and output files.

accuracy_layers.description: Per docs/accuracy.md: status of each layer for this person/session.

error.description: Measured error with units, e.g. 'joint-centre <= 4 mm vs MRI'
